headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 6, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance. The Cincinnati Reds took down the Athletics 6-5, with Brian Serven leading the Athletics' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. The New York Mets secured a convincing 13-6 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, led by Luis Torrens' strong performance. The Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2, with Gary Sánchez leading the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Luinder Avila has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right forearm tightness for the Kansas City Royals. Blake Dunn has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow sprain for the Cincinnati Reds. Ryan Thompson has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a strained lower back for the Arizona Diamondbacks. Hunter Greene has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 2, 2026, with right elbow soreness for the Cincinnati Reds. Sam Bachman has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 3, 2026, with right forearm radial nerve inflammation for the Los Angeles Angels. Patrick Corbin has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left teres major strain for the Toronto Blue Jays. Trey Yesavage has been placed on the 15-day injured list with left knee inflammation for the Toronto Blue Jays. James Wood has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left oblique strain for the Washington Nationals.

The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.
